title: Janssen / Johnson & Johnson
lede: Led product definition and clinical trial programme for a mental health DTx companion to Spravato, in collaboration with Janssen / Johnson & Johnson.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Led product definition, design and agile development of a mental health DTx (Digital Therapeutics) product to be used in combination with Spravato (esketamine) — a treatment for treatment-resistant depression — in collaboration with Janssen / Johnson & Johnson. Included a full clinical trial programme.

sections.title: Key work
sections.body:
• Product definition and roadmap for a DTx companion product
  • Clinical trial design and execution in collaboration with Janssen
  • Integration with Spravato treatment protocol for patients with treatment-resistant depression

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body:
• Successful clinical trial completion
  • 3 digital health patents (System and method for enabling responsive CBT; Computer implemented method and system for scheduling moment-based medical tasks)
